routes.name: Persian Royal Road, Sardis to Susa
citations: Herodotus, Histories 5.52-54 and 8.98, trans. G. C. Macaulay (London: Macmillan, 1890) [public domain]
Pierre Briant, From Cyrus to Alexander: A History of the Persian Empire (Winona Lake: Eisenbrauns, 2002)
routes.notes: Herodotus describes 111 staging posts on a road of about three months' travel from Sardis to Susa, and royal couriers who rode it in relays. The line is our sketch through Anatolia, the upper Tigris and down to Susa.
